verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 300 Gravier Street in the Central Business District of New Orleans.
verified_facts.excerpt: located at 300 Gravier Street in New Orleans

verified_facts.text: The hotel is one block from the French Quarter and the Mississippi River, and within walking distance of the Arts/Warehouse District.

verified_facts.text: Guests arrive through a private walled courtyard, a pocket of seclusion in the middle of downtown.

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 1984.

verified_facts.text: The art collection includes paintings, sculptures, tapestries and furnishings by more than 60 artists, dating from the 17th to the late 20th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Windsor Court features a collection of paintings, sculptures, tapestries and furnishings by more than 60 artists dating from the 17th to late 20th centuries.

verified_facts.text: Many of the artworks are of British origin, with an emphasis on works depicting Windsor Castle and the life of British royalty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of the artworks are of British Origin with an emphasis on works that depict the Windsor Castle and life of British royalty.

verified_facts.text: The collection includes original works by William Powell Frith, Sir Joshua Reynolds, Thomas Gainsborough and Jacob Huntsman.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Collection includes original works by William Powell Frith, Sir Joshua Reynolds, Thomas Gainsborough and Jacob Huntsman.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop saltwater pool has private cabanas and is heated for year-round use.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring private cabanas, our recently renovated 65-foot saltwater pool is cool and refreshing in the summer, and heated for year-round enjoyment

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool and pool bar are framed by views of the New Orleans skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Pool and Pool Bar offer a lush rooftop escape high above the city, framed by sweeping views of the New Orleans skyline.

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has bedside tables with built-in charging stations and bathrooms in Italian marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room & suite has updated in-room amenities, bedside tables with built-in charging stations, and expansive bathrooms filled with rich Italian marble.

verified_facts.text: Most accommodations are true suites, with an entry foyer, living room and bedroom divided by real walls and doors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most of our accommodations are true suites rather than single hotel rooms, with a proper entry foyer, living room, and bedroom divided by real walls and doors

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms begin at 400 square feet.

verified_facts.text: The Club Level occupies floors 19 through 22, with a dedicated concierge and access to the Club Level Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The Club Level Lounge serves breakfast, traditional afternoon tea, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, and nightly desserts and cordials.
